about: Removes xBRZ (TextureFilters_xbrz.*, Zenju, GPL-3.0 only) from the renderer's prebuilt libraries, libGLideNHQ.lib and GLideNUI.lib: GLideN64 is GPL-2.0 only and cannot be combined with it. Applied by tools/build_renderer_libs.py to the pinned upstream tree; each `before` must occur exactly once.

edits.why: The xBRZ enhancement modes enhance nothing, as None does.
edits.after:
case BRZ2X_ENHANCEMENT:
			case BRZ3X_ENHANCEMENT:
			case BRZ4X_ENHANCEMENT:
			case BRZ5X_ENHANCEMENT:
			case BRZ6X_ENHANCEMENT:
				// SM64 Trainer: xBRZ is not in this build (GPL v3 only; renderer/README.md): no enhancement.
			break;

edits.why: No xbrz::scale call: TextureFilters_xbrz.cpp is not compiled.
The xBRZ header is no longer included.
